candidates.name: LIDAR Ground Truth Surveys
verified_facts: EA ground-truth surveys are independently surveyed elevation points on flat unambiguous surfaces, with each point stated at +/-3cm RMSE accuracy.
Timestamped LIDAR surveys are compared against ground truth and must report less than +/-15cm RMSE and 10cm standard-deviation/random-error limits to pass EA quality control.
semantic_limits: A programme QC threshold validates a survey product class; it does not remove parcel-specific raster sampling, geometry, date, transformation or local-surface uncertainty.

candidates.name: LIDAR Composite Catalogues
verified_facts: The EA Composite Catalogues record is an index for full-coverage LIDAR surveys of England.
The catalogue record itself exposes no elevation data services or numeric resources.
semantic_limits: Catalogue/index metadata can identify provenance candidates but cannot be substituted for the actual raster, point cloud or numeric elevation sample used in a parcel result.
